title: html autocomplete and name
name: HTML autocomplete and name — Vercel
overview: Give inputs autocomplete and a meaningful name for assistive and browser fill.
apply_when: HTML form controls that browsers or password managers may autofill.
not_when: Non-HTML or custom controls without name/autocomplete attributes.
agent_hint: Set autocomplete and a meaningful name on every relevant input.
description: Inputs need both `autocomplete` and a meaningful `name`. Pass when those attributes are present and the name is meaningful; fail when `autocomplete` is missing or `name` is missing or meaningless. This supports browser autofill and assistive tooling without inventing extra attributes beyond the cited forms guidance. Apply to HTML controls browsers or password managers may fill.
